about:
# Kindred Forever

A character friends list for **WoW Forever** that is separate from Battle.net. Forever has no character-based friends list, so this keeps your own account-wide list of First + Last names. It also shows presence, zone and map position for friends who run the addon too.

## Install
Install from CurseForge (choose **WoW Forever** in the app), or download the zip from
[Releases](https://github.com/zachroberts8668/kindred/releases) and extract it so you have
`World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\KindredForever\KindredForever.toc`. Then restart the game.

For development, clone this repo and junction it in as `AddOns\KindredForever`.

Blizzard's interface source for Forever is mirrored at
[Gethe/wow-ui-source, branch `forever`](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/tree/forever), which is where the modern look's templates and atlases come from.

## Releasing
Push a tag like `v1.1.0`. The GitHub Action ([BigWigsMods/packager](https://github.com/BigWigsMods/packager))
builds the zip, sets the version from the tag, creates a GitHub release and uploads to CurseForge
(needs the `CF_API_KEY` repo secret and `## X-Curse-Project-ID` in the `.toc`).

## Use
- `/ff` (or `/kin`, or the minimap button) opens the window
- **Add Friend** takes "First Last". **Add Target** adds the player you have targeted. You can also right-click any player (target, party, raid, chat name, /who) and pick **Add to Kindred**
- Search box filters names, notes and zones. **Sort** cycles Status / Name / Level / Zone
- Right-click a friend: Whisper, Invite, Who, Send Title Friend Request, Set Note, Move to Group, per-friend alerts, Remove
- Right-click a group header: rename, reorder, delete, or add a friend to it
- **Options**: hide offline, online/offline alerts, alert sound, level-up alerts, add-back prompts, map position sharing, world map dots, Friends panel tab, mail name completion, window style, minimap button
- **Kindred tab** on Forever's Friends panel opens Kindred docked beside it
- **Mail:** the "To:" box completes friend names; the friends button next to it picks from your list; right-click a friend > Send Mail
- **Options > Window style:** Modern (matches the Friends panel) or Classic
- `/ff alerts`, `/ff minimap`, `/ff refresh`, `/ff style`, `/ff debug`

## How presence works
| Friend… | What you see |
|---|---|
| is your Forever **Title Friend** | Status, level, class and zone from Battle.net (works in instances) |
| runs the addon and has you listed | Online, level, class, zone, AFK/DND, world map dot |
| runs the addon but hasn't added you | "Online - hasn't added you" (no zone) |
| doesn't run the addon | "Online - no addon". Right-click > Who to look up their zone |
| is offline | "Offline - seen 2 days ago in Ironforge" |
| ran the addon but stopped answering | "in an instance?" (addon messages are blocked in dungeons/raids) |

Every 60 seconds the addon sends each friend a hidden addon whisper, at most 3 messages a second. Friends who are offline get checked every other round. When a friend is offline, the server's "No player named X is currently playing" line tells the addon so, and that line is hidden from chat. A friend has to miss two checks in a row before they show as online without the addon. Guild, group, target/mouseover and `/who` sightings fill in the rest. Weaker sources can't overrule a fresh, stronger one, and data older than about 3 minutes falls back to "last seen".

When someone who has you on their list pings you and you don't have them, you get a prompt: **Add / Not Now / Never**.

**Privacy:** your zone, level, class and map position go only to people on *your* list. People not on your list only learn that you're online. Map position sharing can be turned off in Options.

Data is account-wide (`WTF\Account\<account>\SavedVariables\KindredForever.lua`).

releases.notes:
# Kindred Forever

## v1.2.0

- **New look:** the Kindred window now matches Forever's Friends panel, with friend cards, class-coloured level and class, and the same frame, buttons and scroll bar. Prefer the old style? Options > Window style > Classic (or `/ff style`).
- **Kindred tab on the Friends panel:** a new tab under the panel's side tabs opens Kindred right beside it. It closes along with the panel. Can be turned off in Options.
- **Mail:** typing in the "To:" box completes your Kindred friends' names (Tab or Enter accepts). A friends button next to the box lets you pick from your list, and right-clicking a friend while the mailbox is open shows **Send Mail**. Can be turned off in Options.

## v1.1.0

First release.

- A character friends list for WoW Forever, separate from Battle.net. Add friends by First + Last name; the list is shared across all your characters.
- Online/offline status for every friend, with "last seen" time and zone.
- Friends who also run Kindred share their level, class, zone and AFK/DND status, and show as class-colored dots on your world map.
- Title Friends show their status, level and zone, even inside dungeons.
- Online, offline and level-up alerts, with per-friend muting.
- Groups, notes, search, and sorting by status, name, level or zone.
- Right-click a friend to Whisper, Invite, Who, or send a Title Friend request.
- "Add to Kindred" in player right-click menus (chat, party, raid, target, /who).
- Add-back prompt when someone adds you: Add, Not Now or Never.
- Privacy: your zone and map position are only shared with people on your list. Map sharing can be turned off in Options.
- `/ff debug` opens a copyable box for bug reports.
- Commands: `/kin`, `/ff`, `/kindredforever`.
